program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const g = 9.8; const v0 = inputs.launchSpeed; const t = time; const height = v0 * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const velocity = v0 - g * t; const apexTime = v0 / g; const apexHeight = (v0 * v0) / (2 * g); const scaleY = 40; const baseY = 320; const ballY = baseY - height * scaleY; const ballX = 320; let motionState = "Moving up"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "Still for an instant"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = "Moving down"; } const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 60, y: 40, w: 520, h: 360, title: "Vertical Throw", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 160, y: 320, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.line("guide.launch", 150, baseY, 500, baseY, { role: "neutral", opacity: 0.5 })); objects.push(sdk.text("guide.launchL", 90, baseY - 6, "Launch", { align: "middle" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "input" })); if (Math.abs(velocity) > 0.05) { objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 24, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 3, label: "v" })); } objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 36, y: ballY }, { value: -g, direction: "up" }, { scale: 1.5, label: "a", role: "warning" })); objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 60, ballY - 20, [motionState, gravityState], { id: "callout.toss" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: v0, gravity: g, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Observe how gravity slows a tossed ball, stops it for an instant at the top, and pulls it back down.
manifest.description: A ball moves vertically against gravity on a height scale. A blue motion arrow changes with velocity while a dashed gravity arrow stays constant.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
